name: Othello
description: Othello (Reversi) on an 8x8 board, played natively by the board mechanism.

brief.situation: A game of Othello between Black (B) and White (W). Black moves first.
brief.rules: Place a disc on an empty cell (written like d3) so that it closes a straight line of your opponent's discs with one of your own; every closed line flips to your colour. A move must flip at least one disc. If you cannot move, you pass automatically. The game ends when nobody can move; the player with more discs wins.
